nobox.final_span:
Oklahoma Christian at 6 p.m. Monday at the Hegi Family Arena in Oklahoma City.
EL PASO — Western Texas College was defeated by Lamar South Plains College 3-2, as Belinda Lordo and Lino Arciniega scored goals during Western Junior College Athletic Conference play.
Lordo scored at 66:40, and Arciniega at 82:49, tying the game at 2-2.
Bri Thomas scored at 49:49 to secure the Cardinals' lead, and the Wildcats added another goal in the 82nd minute, resulting in the Cardinals having 21 shots compared to just eight for the Matadors, who suffered their first loss (9-1) after beginning the season 7-0.
